Q: How to use COUNTIFS to count referenced cell and another that includes a value A:

You can turn your data into an Excel Table, rename it to TblFlowers, and then use this formula on Sheet2 to count how many times a specific name appears in the Home Design Title column:

=COUNTIF(TblFlowers[Home Design Title], "*" & E5 & "*")

The wildcard * ensures Excel matches the text anywhere inside the cell, even when the description contains additional words.

Q: Mixing YAML and bru requests in the same Bruno collection A:

I was facing the same issue until I find the answer in the Bruno blog post of February 17th.

At the end of the post, in the FAQs section, they indicate :

Can I use both BRU and YAML requests in the same collection?

No, all requests in a collection should be either YAML or BRU.

How do I migrate my existing collection to YAML?

Exporting and re-importing should get it converted to YAML. New collections are in YAML by default.

So the solution seems to be exporting and re-importing collections that are in .bru format.

To export your collection on the Bruno app on MacOS (I guess it is similar on Windows) :

  • click on your collection name

  • click on Share Collection under the Overview tab

  • click on the Export tab

  • select Single File (YAML) format

  • click Proceed and save the .yml file wherever you want

Then, import your collection like so :

  • click the "+" button right next to the label « Collections » on the top left corner

  • click Import collection

  • drag and drop your file or select it via the file explorer

  • make sure that OpenCollection (YAML) is selected as the File Format

  • click Import

Your re-imported collection should now contain .yml files.
